agent_prompt:
# New engineer onboarding checklist

Before starting, confirm:
- HR has marked the hire as started in Workday
- Manager has filled the access request form at https://intranet.example.com/forms/access-request

Follow these steps in order:
1. Create the Okta account using the corporate email from Workday (tool: Okta)
2. Add the account to the engineering group in Okta (tool: Okta)
   - expected: GitHub and Jira SSO work
3. Invite the GitHub user to the organisation with the team listed in the access request form (tool: GitHub)
   - if the role is contractor: invite as an outside collaborator on the named repositories only
4. Add the person to the #eng-announcements and team channels in Slack (tool: Slack)
5. Create the onboarding epic in Jira from template ONB-100 and assign it to the new hire (tool: Jira)
6. Send the welcome message in Slack with the links from doc:onboarding/week-one (tool: Slack)

Decision rules:
- if the start date is more than 7 days away: stop and schedule the checklist for the start date

Never:
- grant admin roles during onboarding
- share credentials over Slack

Done when:
- The new hire can open GitHub, Jira and Slack through Okta

decision_rules.condition: the start date is more than 7 days away
decision_rules.then: stop and schedule the checklist for the start date
